claims.claim: First Solar's SEC-filed Q2 2026 release reported $1.06B net sales, down 4% year over year, $423M net income, $644M adjusted EBITDA, $1.7B net cash and 45.1 GW contracted backlog through 2030; management reaffirmed 2026 guidance.

The revenue decline was attributed primarily to customer contract terminations, partially offset by higher third-party module volume, creating a direct demand-quality signal alongside the large backlog.

risks.risk: Customer contract terminations demonstrate that contracted demand can erode before revenue realization.

contradictions.contradiction: Backlog remains large and guidance was reaffirmed even as current-quarter revenue fell due partly to contract terminations.

unknowns.unknown: Cancellation exposure and economics across the remaining 45.1 GW backlog require contract-level/filing follow-up.

claims.claim: Profitability and backlog support current execution capacity, but observed contract terminations are a concrete falsifier against treating backlog as guaranteed future revenue.

risks.risk: Backlog realization depends on customer commitments, policy/permitting and delivery economics rather than backlog volume alone.

unknowns.unknown: This pass does not quantify policy/tariff sensitivity or cancellation-adjusted backlog economics.
